chunks: Surely a time is fixed for the Day of Judgement.

key_terms.مِيقَاتًا: A fixed time or appointed limit
key_terms.يَوْمَ الْفَصْلِ: The Day of Separation/Decree, referring to the Day of Judgement

ai.seo_question: What is the significance of the Day of Separation in the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the inevitability of Yawm al-Fasl, where the 'separation' refers not only to the division between believers and disbelievers but also to the final judgment of all creation. The concept of 'miqat' (appointed time) highlights God's precise decree, reinforcing the Shia emphasis on divine justice (Adl) where every soul is accounted for without delay. This serves as a spiritual motivator for moral accountability and readiness for the ultimate reckoning.
